summary.headline: Zodiacal Degrees and Horoscope Computations
summary.text: Astrological doctrine on the Bears and their associated climes, followed by the division of zodiacal degrees among planetary rulers and practical horoscopic computations, including the Midheaven, conjunction and full moon, week, sabbath, and year ruler. Cross-references identify folios 261r–264v and parallel chapters in the Hamburg and Vatican codices edited by Roether.
